result.title: HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series
result.comment: 21 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to ICLR 2027
result.summary: Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. We characterize the induced finite-dimensional query space and derive an error decomposition separating functional geometry approximation from learned-memory mismatch. Across continuous-coordinate reconstruction, irregular representation learning, real-world extrapolation, and event-sequence prediction, HiPPO-FM consistently improves strong irregular time-series baselines, achieving strong reconstruction accuracy on Spiral, competitive performance across 20 UEA datasets, improved real-world extrapolation, and superior results on several irregular event benchmarks. After encoding, the compact functional state can be reused across different query sets without reprocessing the observation history.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HiPPO 功能记忆（HiPPO-FM），把不规则时间序列编码为固定秩、可按任意坐标查询并可跨查询集复用的压缩功能状态，通过核平滑 HiPPO 坐标与 Gram 读出统一读写，并给出查询空间与误差分解。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「坐标可寻址、编码后可反复查询而无需重处理历史」的压缩状态与读写几何，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的读取接口、信息保留程度与坍缩诊断提供线索；将误差拆为功能几何近似与记忆失配的思路或可类比 latent 内容保真度分析，但属远领域迁移，需人工核查。
